name: Characters
description: Represents characters in an object that contains text.
remarks: The Characters object lets you modify any sequence of characters contained in the full text string. Use Characters (_start_, _length_), where _start_ is the start character number and _length_ is the number of characters, to return a Characters object.
example:
With Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("B1")
 .Value = "New Title"
 .Characters(5, 5).Font.Bold = True
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the text of this range of characters.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: PhoneticCharacters
properties.description: Returns or sets the phonetic text in the specified Characters object. Read/write String.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a string preceding the selected characters.
